collection.title: Citroen C15 Pickup 1984 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C15 Pickup 1984 to 2006 model requires an 19" wiper blade and the following blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
